problem_contract.desired: Each frozen executed episode has exactly one trade_id-level after-cost cash-flow label containing every broker partial reduction, daily financing allocation, and terminal close exactly once.
problem_contract.as_is: The V1 episode builder selects only the last TRADE_CLOSED row and therefore may omit TRADE_REDUCED and DAILY_FINANCING cash flows.
problem_contract.gap: Reported ALL_TRADES financial metrics can be overstated when omitted cash flows are negative.
problem_contract.counter_hypothesis: The reported candidate correction is wrong if independent raw-transaction aggregation reproduces the V1 labels or if the alleged omitted lines cannot be uniquely allocated to the frozen trade ids.
problem_contract.success: 251 unique trade ids, zero unallocated frozen-trade cash-flow lines, zero duplicate component ids, transaction arithmetic invariants pass, and an independent implementation reproduces every corrected trade label and fixed-window metric.
problem_contract.fail_closed: Any missing raw identity, duplicate component, non-unique episode/trade mapping, raw-vs-normalized mismatch, or unexplained transaction residual makes the affected trade and every aggregate containing it NOT_EVALUABLE.

frozen_cohort.identity: episode_id maps one-to-one to non-null trade_id
frozen_cohort.split: existing 60/40 chronological membership with 1h close-time embargo from split_membership

cashflow_rules.terminal_close: One TRADE_CLOSED event per frozen trade_id; use raw tradesClosed realizedPL, financing, commission, and guaranteedExecutionFee with normalized fields as an equality oracle.
cashflow_rules.partial_reduction: Every TRADE_REDUCED event for a frozen trade_id; use raw tradeReduced realizedPL, financing, guaranteedExecutionFee and the transaction commission exactly once.
cashflow_rules.daily_financing: For every raw DAILY_FINANCING transaction, allocate each openTradeFinancings item by its explicit tradeID. Never allocate the top-level account amount pro-rata.
cashflow_rules.spread_slippage: Already implicit in broker executable fill prices and realizedPL; never subtract displayed halfSpreadCost again.
cashflow_rules.home_conversion_cost: Do not subtract display-only conversion-cost fields unless the account-balance transaction identity proves a separate debit.
cashflow_rules.corrected_net: sum(realizedPL + financing + commission + guaranteedExecutionFee) across partial reductions and terminal close, plus all allocated DAILY_FINANCING financing for the trade.
cashflow_rules.component_identity: raw transaction id plus component kind plus trade_id plus component ordinal
cashflow_rules.ordering: Numeric OANDA transaction id, then raw timestamp. Unknown within-bar market ordering is UNRESOLVED, never inferred from OHLC.

multidimensional_cube.selection_rule: Never select one point from the full Cartesian product. Preserve sparse labelled missingness, require a connected stable TRAIN plateau/Pareto set, then freeze before VALIDATION.
